title: Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) Method for Studying Magnetic Behaviors in Trinuclear Cobalt(II) Compound
abstract: AbstractA CoII coordination polymer built from a mixed azide and zwitterionic pyridinium ions and its temperature‐dependent magnetic properties are described. We used the Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) method to fit the data, and found the following results: (1) there are strong correlations between the model parameters; (2) the data at above 28 K are well fitted by the magnetism model.
